Brief

Only use footage from the Variety interview in the Drive link below. No other footage.

Nothing is required in your caption. No hashtags or tags needed.

Keep it positive about Jo and keep it true. No made-up facts or quotes.

Original audio only. Clips must be at least 10 seconds, in English.

Keep every post up for 30 days with likes visible.

At least 0.20% engagement on every post.

75%+ of your views must come from the US. DM Eclipse your demographics (an analytics screen recording) in the Whop support chat to get paid.

Full brief and footage are in the links below.

Creator requirements

Clipping, comedy, entertainment and fan pages with a mostly US audience. Any page size is welcome.
